title: Playwright fails with 'libglib-2.0.so.0: cannot open shared object file' on a Nixpacks build
symptoms: libglib-2.0.so.0: cannot open shared object file
Browser binary is installed but launch fails
cause: playwright install --with-deps needs apt-get, which the Nixpacks build sandbox does not offer, so the fallback installed the browser without its system libraries.
fix: Build from the official Playwright Docker image, keeping its tag in step with the playwright package version.
